jobs.prompt: Small ticket: show non-Claude orchestrators (opencode, Codex, any CLI) on the board's Orchestrator panel and count their tokens. Read tools/board-orchestrator.mjs (projectOrchestrator builds per-project session cards from Claude Code events and transcripts), tools/orchestrator-usage.mjs (token and cost from transcripts), tools/orchestrator-events.mjs. (1) OPENCODE DETECTION: new tools/external-orchestrators.mjs, read-only. opencode keeps sessions in a SQLite database at ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db (override with env SWARM_OPENCODE_DB, XDG_DATA_HOME honoured) with table `session` columns id, project_id, parent_id, directory, title, cost (real, USD as reported), tokens_input, tokens_output, tokens_reasoning, tokens_cache_read, tokens_cache_write, agent, model, time_created, time_updated, time_archived (integer milliseconds). Read it ONLY through the sqlite3 command line tool in read-only mode (execFile 'sqlite3', ['-readonly','-json', dbPath, SQL], timeout 3000 ms, no shell; node:sqlite is not available on the Node 20 CI) with a fixed SQL string (no user input in SQL): sessions with parent_id IS NULL and time_archived IS NULL whose directory is inside a registered project root (realpath compare) and time_updated within the last 24 h; if sqlite3 or the file is missing return [] quietly. Never open or read auth.json, the credential or account tables, message or part content, or tool-output: select only the columns listed. Map each session to a card in the same shape as the Claude ones in projectOrchestrator (id short, project, state: 'working' if time_updated within 90 s else 'idle', lastAt, tool:'opencode', model, tokensToday = sum of tokens_input+output+reasoning (and separately cacheRead) for sessions updated today with a per-day split when possible using message time ranges is NOT needed: attribute the whole session's total to today if time_updated is today, and mark approximate:true when the session started before today), cost = the session's cost field reported by opencode (label costSource:'reported by opencode', not a list-price estimate; keep it separate from listUsd for Claude), and add them to the project's orchestrator sessions list and totals WITHOUT double counting; expose through the existing data shape (add fields tool, model, costUsdReported). (2) GENERIC REGISTER: `swarm orchestrator register --tool NAME --model MODEL [--project ROOT] [--session ID]` writes/updates a small JSON file under that project's .swarm/orchestrators/<tool>-<id>.json (fields tool, model, pid optional, startedAt, lastHeartbeat, tokensToday optional, costUsd optional) and `swarm orchestrator heartbeat --session ID [--tokens N] [--cost-usd X] [--state working|idle]` updates lastHeartbeat and counters; `swarm orchestrator list [--json]` prints them; entries without a heartbeat for 10 minutes are shown idle and after 24 h dropped. Validate every field (tool and model are short printable text, numbers are non-negative finite, no paths in names, atomic writes). Registered orchestrators appear on the same board cards (tool name, model, state, tokensToday, cost as reported). Register/heartbeat/list are plain swarm commands (add to watch-command-meta and completion; they are allowed by orchestrator mode). (3) SHARE: wherever the project computes orchestrator token totals for the worker vs orchestrator share (look for tokensToday / orchestrator share code in tools/board-*.mjs and tools/orchestrator-usage.mjs), include the external orchestrators' tokens so their use counts as orchestrator tokens; if the share code is not on main yet, expose a function externalOrchestratorTokens(projects) the share code can call, with a test. Tests (tests/external-orchestrators.test.mjs, no real sqlite3 or database: inject the exec function and a fake DB output; plus register/heartbeat/list round trips in a temp dir, stale and dropped rules, validation rejections, never-read-secret-tables assertion on the SQL string, directory-inside-project matching with symlinks). Do not edit the board's front-end files (the board owner renders the new fields); do not touch tools/swarm.mjs beyond the command dispatch lines if unavoidable.
